Name: Jelly Slimes
Author: GlacialGalaxies
Description:
This mod uses content patcher to retexture slimes and make them look slightly more like jelly. Slime = gelatinous blob. Jelly = gelatinous blob. Coincidence? I don't know but they are now one. Please don't eat the slimes.

The sprites are originally from my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22973]Slime Potions[/url]﻿. Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/106700933]mugk1tt1[/url] for the suggestion to apply them to wild slimes!

Let me know if you have any concerns or comments!

Downloads.Description: Now changes all vanilla slimes! Also adds a toggle to give tiger slimes ears. Hopefully I fixed everything!
